name: babiespicks
description: Saudi baby product editorial platform with MCP content management

scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @babiespicks/web build && pnpm --filter @babiespicks/mcp build
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web apps/mcp/src packages/domain/src packages/db/src scripts/simplification --config eslint.config.ts
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @babiespicks/db type-check && pnpm --filter @babiespicks/domain type-check && pnpm --filter @babiespicks/web type-check && pnpm --filter @babiespicks/mcp type-check
